name: Archie Poker
description: Archie Poker (Archie) is a triple draw high/low split poker game. Five cards each; three draw rounds with betting (small, small, big, big). Pot is split between best qualifying high hand (pair of 9s or better, house rules vary) and best qualifying low (eight or better, ace-to-five). No qualifying high allows low to scoop; no qualifiers may split or go to best hand (house rules). Considered one of the most complex poker variants because hand value shifts across draws.
players: 2-6 (often capped at 6 to avoid deck shortage)
